verdict.rationale: Penpot has no evidenced native, in-product AI insight or suggestion feature. AI analysis of your design data comes through bringing your own external agent or LLM via the official MCP server, which lets agents read and interact with design files (penpot-docs-1, penpot-docs-32, penpot-docs-27), or through community AI plugins in the marketplace (penpot-docs-24). Missing for 10: a first-party in-app AI assistant that generates insights or suggestions, documentation of what kinds of insights an agent or plugin produces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
